task_description: First-build scaffold of the ProFit gym operations management system: Django + DRF serverless (Vercel) monorepo with Supabase PG via the ORM, custom User + single-sourced RBAC, membership Module 1 (real models + DRF read API + staff web shell), billing Module 2 (stubs + a concrete race-safe PayMongo webhook per Revision 4), finance Module 3 (stubs + Owner-only gate), pg_cron expiry SQL stub, web portal shell (build-time Tailwind/daisyUI, one django-component, one HTMX partial, inline Lucide SVG), and an RN mobile skeleton using the binding CSRF token-echo auth sequence. Acceptance: python manage.py check and test pass offline on Python 3.13; verification recorded to verification.md.
